subject: UX spec: sparkline zero-attempt fallback state
body:
## Spec: Sparkline Zero-Attempt Fallback State

**Priority:** Medium UX
**Affects:** index.html — buildSparkline() / dashboard exam cards

### Problem
When Kai has 0 attempts on an exam, the sparkline renders nothing. The exam card shows just the title and link with no visual indicator of status. First-time users have no visual differentiation between 'never started' and 'previously failed.'

### Behavior Spec
When `s.attempts.length === 0` (no attempt data for this exam):
- Show a muted placeholder in place of the sparkline
- The placeholder signals 'not started yet' without showing fake data

### State Machine
States: zero | has-data
Variables: attemptCount (number)
Transitions:
- zero -> has-data: user submits at least 1 exam result for this exam
Edge cases:
- Has 1 attempt (not 2): sparkline code currently requires >= 2 for rendering. Apply same fallback.

### Visual Spec
Zero state placeholder:
```css
.sparkline-zero {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 40px;
  height: 20px;
  border-bottom: 2px dashed var(--text-muted);
  opacity: 0.5;
}
```
Optional: add a small label `aria-label="Not yet attempted"` on the container.

### Copy
- No visible copy needed. aria-label only: "Not yet attempted"

### Acceptance Criteria
1. When attempts.length === 0, a dashed muted line appears where the sparkline would be
2. When attempts.length === 1, same dashed muted line (not enough data for trend)
3. When attempts.length >= 2, existing sparkline renders as today
4. Zero state passes contrast check (var(--text-muted) at 3.5:1+ on card background)
5. aria-label on zero state reads 'Not yet attempted'
6. No console errors for zero-attempt exams

### What NOT to Change
- Sparkline rendering when attempts >= 2 (leave as-is)
- Up Next card logic (separate from sparkline)
- Any other exam card elements

### Related Specs
- da-16 audit confirmed: no fallback state exists today
